gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-nko: Expressive from the first glance, Bruno Ace draws every line with a ruler's constant width. Noto Sans NKo is the quieter one, with c openings you can see through, and it does the reading work.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoin: Distinctive and a bit mechanical, Bruno Ace keeps each diagonal as stout as each upright, and Noto Sans NKo Unjoined follows with wide, friendly openings. Bigger heading, smaller body works here.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-old-south-: Bruno Ace lingers over each letter, its counters staying connected to the outside and its line width constant through curves and straights. And Noto Sans Old South Arabian keeps going in a clean, approachable way, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-overpass: Bruno Ace is all ruler-drawn constant width, with counters that stay connected to the outside. And Overpass carries a longer page in modern sans-serif form, light and bold strokes never mixing within a word.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-palanquin: Bruno Ace is drawn with a ruler, one constant-width line throughout. Make it small and that stout, pipe-cleaner stroke crowds up, while Palanquin, with its wide, unclosed mouths on curved letters, only gets more comfortable when set large.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-red-hat-text: Technical, spacious, a little showy. Bruno Ace is the one for lingering, expressive display lettering, and Red Hat Text is the sans-serif that does the quieter work, with its drafting-pen line weight and relaxed, curvy forms.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-reddit-sans: Bruno Ace lingers on every character, its counters staying connected to the outside and its line unvarying. And Reddit Sans matches that steadiness with a thickness that ignores direction, plus an e with a wide gap at its terminal.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-roboto-flex: Approachable on the body side and expressive on top, this pairing sets Bruno Ace's ruler-drawn line against something looser. Roboto Flex brings a wide slot between the c's two ends, and that openness is the strongest thing the pair has.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ruluko: Broad, open counters on c and s give Ruluko a clean, approachable read. Bruno Ace is best at holding a display line of unswelling, constant width, while Ruluko is best at quiet, sans-serif text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-sarabun: Ruler-straight and unhurried, Bruno Ace has no thin hairline set against a thick stem anywhere in it. Sarabun is the working text, with a wide channel into every bowl.
